bullets.text: Avadi experienced heavy rain resulting in water stagnation on roads, and the office should monitor drainage operations.
The Met department issued a heavy rain alert for Chennai and Thiruvallur, so disaster response teams must stay prepared.
Sewage vehicle owners protested by parking vehicles inside the Gummidipoondi block development office, and local officials should resolve their grievances.
Vultr plans to build one gigawatt of AI capacity in India positioning Chennai centrally, and the ministry should support data center expansion.
Corning has expanded optical manufacturing for AI data centers while starting its Chennai cover-glass plant, highlighting local industrial growth.
Global AI stock sell-offs due to return on investment concerns put Indian IT firms in focus, presenting a strategic market opportunity.
Ration goods are being delivered directly to the homes of senior citizens and persons with disabilities, and the district teams should oversee execution.
